changes.year1_quote: At December 31, 2021, if interest rates were to increase instantaneously by 200 basis points, the simulation indicated that the net market value of our portfolio of assets and liabilities would increase by 12.23%, and conversely, if interest rates were to decrease instantaneously by 200 basis points, the simulation indicated that the net market value of our assets and liabilities would decrease by 7.11%.

changes.reasoning: The same net market value sensitivity risk, portfolio, policy tolerance, and ±200-basis-point scenarios remain explicitly disclosed in Candidate 1. Although the direction and magnitude of the modeled outcomes changed materially, those are updated sensitivity results rather than a change in the underlying economic risk disclosure.
